description: Search the aitools.obzdn.co directory of AI and open-source tools for owner-operators and small teams. Returns up to `limit` tools, best match and highest-rated first, with what each does, who it fits, starting price, the catch to watch for, OBZDN's rating (top pick / also good / listed, and why), and links.

audience.description: Optional audience id, e.g. trades (trades and home services), local (gyms, salons, studios, shops), pros (consultants, agencies, freelancers), creators, marketers

category.description: Optional category id from https://aitools.obzdn.co/tools.json, e.g. missed-calls, estimates, scheduling, bookkeeping, reviews, content, email-marketing, local-seo

max_monthly_usd.description: Optional: only tools whose starting price is at or under this many dollars

open_source_only.description: Optional: only free and open-source tools

picks_only.description: Optional: only OBZDN top picks (what we recommend for this need)

query.description: What the business needs, in plain words, e.g. 'answer missed calls for a plumber'

name: search_tools
title: Search AI tools for small businesses
